Block4: The place changes even if the PCs stand still. Local people, creatures, weather, signage, and ward behavior all keep moving around the scene. Taking hospitality as entitlement lowers trust. Road news can turn the room from warm to grieving fast. Corporate language makes the co-op feel inspected. A familiar item from the road is recognized. A gift is offered with hands that shake. The ward chime outside flattens while everyone pretends not to hear it. Let the place be funny through overconfident signage, awkward forms, stubborn local habits, and magic that refuses corporate language.
